rules.title: Bulk Complaint Level threshold is between 4 and 6
rules.name: Name
rules.description: The bulk complaint level (BCL) separates bulk mail from spam. Every anti-spam policy should use a BulkThreshold between 4 (Strict) and 6 (Standard); a higher value lets more bulk mail through, a too low value may be too aggressive. Note: ORCA only scores policies that are enabled and actually applied to users (through rules or preset policies); this rule cannot see policy assignment, so every policy returned by the cmdlet is evaluated.
rules.remediation:
Set BulkThreshold to 6 (Standard) or 4 (Strict) in each anti-spam policy.

Microsoft Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Threat policies > Anti-spam > policy > Bulk email threshold. PowerShell: Set-HostedContentFilterPolicy -Identity <policy> -BulkThreshold 6
